prompts.prompt: Wide shot inside a striped circus tent in Stockholm, a solitary acrobat suspended on aerial silks under a single warm spotlight, dusty red velvet seats curving away in soft focus with one spectator's silhouette in the foreground.

Medium shot of a magician in a black tailcoat performing a sleight-of-hand card trick, hands sharp in focus under a tight white spotlight, dark stage fading to black around him with faint blue haze drifting past.

Inside a Stockholm black-box studio theater with exposed brick walls and visible overhead rigging, a contortionist bending backward on a low wooden platform under cool white working lights, a stagehand adjusting a cable in the background.

Extreme close-up of a performer's chalk-dusted hand gripping a polished brass juggling club, blurred red stage curtain and Stockholm theater scaffolding behind, lit by a single warm amber sidelight that catches the dust on his knuckles.
